statements.text: ADD-03 2.1 changes the definition of Estimated Project Cost. It is no longer the figure in the agreed Financial Model at Financial Close. It is now the figure the Bidder states in Form 4-F, excluding financing costs, interest during construction and development fees.

evidence.words: ‘as set out in the agreed Financial Model at Financial Close’ is deleted and ‘as stated by the Bidder in Form 4-F, excluding financing costs, interest during construction and development fees’ is substituted

statements.text: ADD-03 3.1 replaces the fixed net-worth threshold of SAR 800,000,000 in VOL-I 8.4 with 25% of the Estimated Project Cost.

evidence.words: In Volume I Clause 8.4, ‘SAR 800,000,000’ is deleted and ‘twenty-five per cent (25%) of the Estimated Project Cost’ is substituted.

statements.text: ADD-03 does not change how the Financial Model must be built: the format requirements in VOL-I 10.3 are unchanged. The build activity's scope, owner and lead time stay the same. The model still has to produce the Estimated Project Cost figure that Form 4-F asks for, now on the new excluded-costs basis.

evidence.words: excluding financing costs, interest during construction and development fees

statements.text: Under amended VOL-I 8.4, the net-worth test in Envelope A is measured against the Estimated Project Cost the Bidder states in Form 4-F (Envelope B). So the Estimated Project Cost has to be fixed in the frozen Financial Model before the financial-standing calculation (fin-standing) can be finished. This is an inferred sequencing link for a person to confirm. It is not stated in the pack.

evidence.words: ‘twenty-five per cent (25%) of the Estimated Project Cost’ is substituted
‘as stated by the Bidder in Form 4-F, excluding financing costs, interest during construction and development fees’ is substituted

payload.why: ADD-03 2.1 changes only what Estimated Project Cost means: the figure stated in Form 4-F, excluding financing costs, interest during construction and development fees. It does not change how the Financial Model must be built, and VOL-I 10.3 is not amended by ADD-03. The build activity's name, owner, resource, lead time (fin_model_build) and predecessors therefore stay as they are. The modeller should report Estimated Project Cost on the new excluded-costs basis; that is a matter of content, not of the activity. A person must confirm.

The pack links the two only through the amended definition. Is the new successor link to fin-standing right? A person must confirm. items.model_rationale: The duration key (fin_model_freeze) and predecessors are unchanged. The only proposed change is a new successor, fin-standing, because VOL-I 8.4(a) as amended now measures net worth against the Estimated Project Cost stated in Form 4-F.

payload.why: Insufficient evidence. The ADD-03 response to Q17 says the reference specific energy consumption and the format of the Energy Performance Statement are in Appendix C to the Addendum. So there is nothing to quote for the reference value or the format. The Appendix C document is missing, or was left out of the evidence build. A person must get it, through the Portal or from document control, before any row, evidence item or activity for criterion G can rest on it.
